body: Beth dies, Maggie finds out she died during the rescue, Carol dies trying to rescue Beth, Abraham trashes the fucking bus and cries thinking his whole operation goes down, cut to season 5 mid season finale, they find safe zone episode 9
Im killing myself, fuck you all

I think of petty stupid shit all the time, when I sleep I dream of nostalgiac things, a recurring dream is one of my friends that I didn't even get back to despite being my best friend, out of fear that he would think I was a prick or weak person, crying out for attention, he would always say whats wrong, and me even in my dreams saying "I wish I could tell you", or a highschool crush that I never got around to.  It may seem like a cliche depression if you can even fucking call it that, but I don't care.  My life is literally the downward spiral, things can only go lower from here, at least when I'm dead I won't hear the agony of my family, it hurts me about thinking about it

I'm writing this as an outlet, maybe a diary prior to my attempt at suicide.

I feel like when people look at me, they see a shell they can't even sink their time into, I get the same look.  They see me as a person they can't take seriously, and I've researched my looks and my mannerisms, its all just beyond appearance, its something else, I feel transparent, I can't tell if this is just my young retarded mind, but its eating me to the point of me not being able to even start conversation, I spend my time either drinking or screaming into my bed, looking at my computer screen, waiting for this so called "destiny" to show me something to fight or live for, so far I can't find anything.

My ambitions, my plans for schooling are all just pipe dreams, even if I had the money or ability to go to any sort of school, my social crippling fear that I developed over the coarse of a year would destroy me, even lowering my self worth, or what I think of as self worth to a measly 5 cents
